subject: website
name: IPFS blog
summary: A build of the IPFS blog, open source (MIT). Its home page runs no third-party code and makes no request beyond its own files, which is Level 3. It is not judged Level 4: many of its files, posts and sitemap included, could not be fetched from IPFS on 2026-10-05, so what they load could not be checked.
